agent_profiles.name: counterexample_first
agent_profiles.instruction: Prefer the answer that survives the strongest counterexample supported by the prompt.

agent_profiles.name: surface_match
agent_profiles.instruction: Favor the answer that most directly matches the question and choices without adding extra assumptions.

agent_profiles.name: plausibility_first
